description.value:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Seventh Sense]

You have forced the sky's hand. Treat today as Exalted: your Zenith Boon is active for 1 minute.

If the day was already Exalted, your Zenith Boon instead extends to all allies within 30 feet for 1 minute.

Apply your Cloth's Sky: Zenith effect alongside this one for the duration, or use the sky tracker's Burn Cosmo control, which does it for you and reverts when the minute ends.
